SEc. 3. The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include the
17 per cent special excise tax on Foreign Exchange on the
basic material for locally prepared coffee and on fishing
twines, 7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of June, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-one, and of
the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO.
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Assistant Executive Secretary
